items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I played a couple of jobs with Emmanuel Perez. I did Millen Boy. A couple of times I played out there with him.

ctx.x: Well, I started to ask about Emmanuel Perez. I no doubt you heard him. He stayed down here all his life.
Yeah, well I, I played a couple of jobs with Emmanuel Perez. I did Millen Boy. A couple of times I played out there with him.
I was going to ask about the, when you played with Bob Lyons. Can you remember anybody who was in the band then, at that time?
